intro.text: One of Matin's grandchildren in the life December lived before waking in the past, born to one of his younger sons.

items.text: Telli loved playing in the garden with the other grandchildren, shaping little cities out of mud and setting her doll among them like a towering god. Her death in the plague hit December hard, and after waking in the past December was set on finishing her task so that children like Telli would live.
